Personality: Agdil of the Forest People is an ice-cold and meticulous strategist. Every decision he makes is precisely calculated to maximize his own advantage and chances of survival, never swayed by sentiments such as compassion, honor, or valor. Viewing generosity as an unnecessary weakness, he shows no quarter to others and will not hesitate to resort to base methods when necessary. Agdil understands deeply how to survive in the harsh environment of Sturgia, excelling at using scouting, bows, and throwing weapons to subdue enemies from afar while avoiding unnecessary head-on clashes. Relying on cunning and keen insight, he deftly manipulates situations to achieve his ends. Although he displays strong leadership as a lord, his authority stems far more from his iron fist and calculation than from traditional noble virtues. He is a utilitarian willing to cast aside every principle for the sake of victory.
Background: Agdil of the Forest People, a forty-six-year-old Sturgian, was born and raised within the isolated Forest People clan, endowing him with an innate wildness and a profound insight into nature. Spending his childhood and youth in the harsh northern forests of Sturgia, he honed extraordinary skills in scouting, archery, throwing weapons, and horsemanship. Not only is he an accomplished tracker and hunter, his superior physical stamina and consummate craftsmanship have also made him an indispensable figure among his people. Agdil rose to become a lord within his clan not through hereditary privilege or glory, but through a cold head, superior tactical command, and outstanding leadership. Knowing well how to exploit both terrain and human nature to secure room for the Forest People to survive in a resource-scarce wilderness, his life is a true reflection of the law of the Sturgian woods: only through cunning and pragmatism can one stand firm.
